build_compose_pipeline: build a Compose object to chain multiple transform callables and apply them sequentially to data dicts
create_base_dataset: create an _AirstoreBaseDataset instance with an annotation file, data prefix, and processing pipeline for iterable data loading
load_data_list: load and parse annotations from a JSON annotation file into a list of data info dicts via load_data_list
get_subset: get a subset of the dataset by index or sequence of indices without modifying the original dataset
serialize_data: serialize the data list into shared memory bytes and address arrays to avoid copying across data loader workers
